info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Segment Editor API
info.description: The SegmentEditor API lets you add, update, delete custom Segments, and list saved segments.

Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website to query.
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.
(Required) The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).
(Required) Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.
